empty.noRelease: No embedded release available for the connected chain.
empty.noGames: No games registered in the active release.

hero.title: Enter the Floor
hero.description: All modules are 100% on-chain, verifiable, and connected directly to the isolated reserve bank. Play directly from your wallet.

noRelease.title: No release loaded
noRelease.description: The embedded release snapshot is unavailable.

header.title: Sportsbook Control Room
header.description: Fixed-odds sports markets stay behind explicit launch controls. This entry exposes the deployed SportsHub surface, release risk caps, and the signed-odds ticket path when the frontend gate is enabled.

riskCard.description: Open a market detail page and provide a signed odds snapshot before placement.

release.title: Oracle and settlement surface
release.description: The active bundle exposes signed odds identity, result reporter quorum, and the bootstrap dispute roles needed by SportsHub settlement.

mvp.title: Football 1X2 readiness
mvp.description: The current provider path is scoped to pre-match fixed odds, signed snapshots, and explicit result evidence before any public launch decision.

caps.title: Top-level SportsHub limits
caps.description: These raw-unit caps are copied from the embedded release and should stay aligned with the deployment bundle and ops approval memos.

marketTape.title: Recent SportsHub markets
marketTape.description: The frontend reads the latest on-chain SportsHub market ids directly through the v1.3 SDK. Ticket placement is only available from a market detail page after the signed-odds gate is satisfied.

lookup.title: Inspect SportsHub records
lookup.description: Lookup stays read-only and goes through the v1.3 SDK. Use market detail for the signed-odds ticket flow.
lookup.marketEmpty: Enter a SportsHub market id to inspect state, result status, and reserved exposure.
lookup.ticketEmpty: Enter a SportsHub ticket id to inspect position, stake, payout, and ticket state.

operator.title: Market and result administration
operator.description: Governance and reporter actions are exposed as typed SDK calls for authorized wallets. Public ticket placement uses a separate signed-odds path and contract roles still enforce every write.
operator.walletRoleRequired: Wallet role must be authorized on SportsHub.

bankroll.title: Sports pool isolation
bankroll.description: Sports liquidity is kept separate from casino game liquidity, so sportsbook exposure can be capped, paused, and monitored independently.
bankroll.noPool: No Sports pool metadata is available in this release.

controls.title: Launch blockers remain explicit
controls.description: The page is intentionally operational: it keeps the SportsHub deployment visible while preserving the public-launch blockers tracked in the ops packet.

marketTape.empty: No SportsHub markets have been created in this release yet.

noRelease.title: No release loaded
noRelease.description: The embedded release snapshot is unavailable.

detail.title: Market {marketId}
detail.description: Direct SportsHub readback for one fixed-odds market. Ticket placement stays behind the frontend release gate and requires a complete signed odds snapshot before broadcast.

invalid.title: Invalid market id
invalid.description: SportsHub market routes require a numeric market id.

readFailed.title: Market readback failed
readFailed.description: The SDK could not read this SportsHub market from the active release.

loading.title: Loading market
loading.description: Reading market, result, and exposure records through the v1.3 SDK.

market.title: Lifecycle and result
market.description: Market state is read directly from SportsHub. Result state is displayed when a reporter proposal exists.

exposure.title: Reserved capital
exposure.description: These values are the on-chain exposure readback used by ops to validate market, outcome, event, and pool-event caps.

ticketPlacement.title: Signed odds ticket
ticketPlacement.description: This is the only public risk-in path for the MVP: it plans ERC20 approval, validates the signed odds snapshot against the active market, then calls SportsHub.placeTicket through the SDK.
ticketPlacement.marketMustBeOpen: Market must be open before ticket placement.
ticketPlacement.walletAndSnapshotRequired: A connected wallet and signed odds snapshot are required.

ticketTerminal.title: Settle, refund, or void tickets
ticketTerminal.description: Debt-out calls remain wallet-gated and use SportsHub terminal helpers. Inspect a ticket before broadcasting to verify the state and payout path.
ticketTerminal.walletRequired: A connected wallet is required to broadcast terminal ticket calls.

noMarket.title: No market data
noMarket.description: No market was returned for this id from the active SportsHub.

validation.outcomeNonNegative: Outcome id must be a non-negative integer.
validation.outcomeRange: Outcome id must be between 0 and {max}.

summary.gateHelper: Requires enabled release metadata, frontend flag, and wallet.

ticketPlacement.walletRequired: Connect a wallet to place tickets.

plan.empty: Paste a signed odds snapshot from the provider path, plan it, then submit through the SDK. Unsigned or stale odds are rejected before broadcast.

validation.oneTicket: Enter at least one ticket id.

summary.walletHelper: Terminal ticket calls are public, but still require a wallet.

ticketTerminal.empty: Inspect a ticket to verify position id, stake, payout, and terminal state before broadcasting debt-out.
